_doc: Floor guardians (floors 1-4), in order. Each: name, intro (shown before the fight), level, loss_health (health lost on defeat), monsters [{class, slot [col,row], level_offset?, name?}]. 'crystal': the final chamber (06-crystal-of-remembrance.md): name and intro only; the fight itself is CombatSim.simulate_crystal. Placeholders that escalate floor by floor.

guardians.name: The Sentinel Warden
guardians.intro: At the foot of the first stair stands a sentinel older than the stair. Its post was given to it before Lanternrest had a name, and it has not been relieved. Rats nest in the cracks of its feet, and fight for it as if it were their god.

guardians.name: The Lantern Thieves
guardians.intro: Wisps gather where lanterns die, and here a hundred lanterns died at once. They wear the last light of every party that fell on this floor, and they would very much like yours.

guardians.name: The Choir of the Unremembered
guardians.intro: They sing in the voices of the people they have eaten. You know some of the voices. The [fade]grey[/fade] behind them is listening, and every verse takes something from the room.

guardians.name: The Gate of Seals
guardians.intro: The Lumari sealed the Crystal's chamber behind a gate that judges. Two sentinels hold it, and the wraiths that serve it remember every party that was found wanting.

crystal.name: The Crystal of Remembrance
crystal.intro: The chamber is the [crystal]Crystal[/crystal] itself, grown through the rock like frost through glass. It does not fight. It only remembers, and as you chip a Shard from it, the memories it holds wake and stand between you and the light. There is no way back up from here.
